title: Red Hat Security Advisory: freerdp security update
description: Multiple denial of service vulnerabilities have been identified in FreeRDP, a free implementation of the Remote Desktop Protocol. These include issues with uninitialized progressive tile handling, heap-based buffer overflow during MP3 audio decoding, and heap out-of-bounds write in NTLM authentication. Red Hat has issued an important security update addressing these flaws in FreeRDP for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 Extended Update Support and related products.
